candidates.topic: World Diabetes Day (Nov 14) — diabetes prevention/management content
candidates.recommended_angle: Connect annual observance to genuine 2026 shift — GLP-1 integration into type 2 diabetes management landscape and what it means for patients not on these drugs.
candidates.why_now: Nov 14 is the fixed WHO/IDF World Diabetes Day observance date. Fresh angle required because competitors will publish generic static prevention tips; differentiate by focusing on the care-landscape shift this year.
candidates.primary_headline: World Diabetes Day 2026: What's Actually Changed in Diabetes Care This Year
candidates.next_steps: Develop 900-1100 word explainer with current-year prevalence statistics and clinical guideline context; lead with GLP-1 landscape shift, not universal recommendation.
integrity_flags: Verify current-year (2026) IDF/ADA diabetes prevalence and incidence statistics directly before publishing — do not reuse prior-year figures.
Frame GLP-1 integration as a care-landscape shift, not a universal recommendation — avoid implying all type 2 patients need or should seek these drugs.
candidates.trend_score_reason: Fixed annual observance with established search volume plus genuine fresh angle (GLP-1 care shift) driving differentiation opportunity.
candidates.opportunity_score_reason: High editorial gap — most coverage will be generic tips; service angle on medication landscape creates competitive advantage.
candidates.discover_score_reason: Broad audience appeal (diabetes affects 37M+ Americans) with timely observance hook and actionable management information.
candidates.notes: Estimated word count 900-1100; lead with 'what changed this year' framing to differentiate from competitors' static prevention content.
